components.name: Alert
components.purpose: An alert shows a message about the page or the result of an action: information, success, a warning or an error.

components.name: AppsNotifications
components.purpose: A settings panel with one switch per app, to turn each app’s notifications on or off.

components.name: Avatar
components.purpose: An avatar represents a person or team with their photo, or their initials when there’s no photo.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: A button triggers an action in place: saving a form, opening a dialog, deleting an item.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.purpose: A button group shows related buttons together, spaced or attached into one control.

components.name: Card
components.purpose: A card groups content and actions about one subject, such as an article, a product or a person, into a single container.

components.name: Checkbox
components.purpose: A checkbox turns one option on or off, or lets people pick any number of options from a list.

components.name: ChooseCard
components.purpose: Choose cards are large radio buttons: each option is a card with a name, a description and an optional price, and people pick exactly one.

components.name: Combobox
components.purpose: A combobox is a text field with a list of suggestions: people type to filter and pick one option, or several shown as removable chips.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.purpose: A dropdown menu shows a list of actions or options when people press a button.

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: The page footer: a copyright line and secondary links such as Privacy, Terms and Help.

components.name: FormField
components.purpose: FormField puts a label, help text and an error or success message around a form control and wires them together, so screen readers announce the label, hint and error with the control.

components.name: Header
components.purpose: A page header that introduces a person and their page: avatar, name, job title and the page heading.

components.name: InputField
components.purpose: An input field lets people enter a single line of text: a name, an email address, a search term.

components.name: Link
components.purpose: A link takes people to another page or place.

components.name: Logo
components.purpose: The logo shows the product’s mark and name, usually at the start of the navigation bar, linking to the home page.

components.name: MeetingCard
components.purpose: A meeting card shows one event in an agenda or schedule: its name, time and attendees, with a color edge for its status.

components.name: Navbar
components.purpose: The navigation bar at the top of a site or app: the logo, links to the main sections, and optional actions such as search.

components.name: Pagination
components.purpose: Pagination moves between pages of a long list or table.

components.name: ProductCard
components.purpose: A product card shows one product in a grid or list: photo, name, short description, rating and price, with an optional sale price and actions.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.purpose: A radio group lets people pick exactly one option from a short list, with every option visible at once.

components.name: SearchField
components.purpose: A search field has a search icon, a clear button and an optional keyboard shortcut that focuses it from anywhere on the page.

components.name: Select
components.purpose: A select lets people pick one option from a list that opens below the field.

components.name: Slider
components.purpose: A slider sets a number, or a range with two thumbs, by dragging along a track or with the arrow keys.

components.name: Switch
components.purpose: A switch turns a single setting on or off and applies the change immediately, like a light switch.

components.name: Tabs
components.purpose: Tabs switch between related views of content in the same place, one at a time.

components.name: Textarea
components.purpose: A multi-line text field for longer answers such as messages, comments or descriptions.
